title: Two police officers shot, suspect dead after car chase in Connecticut
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Two police officers were shot and a suspect is dead after an attempted arrest turned into a car chase and deadly shootout near Connecticut’s capital late Friday night.

Cops were investigating “illegal activity” just outside of Hartford at around 11 p.m. when a male suspect fled the scene on foot, Hartford Police Lieutenant Aaron Boisvert told WTNH.

When the officers attempted to arrest the unnamed man, they felt an object they “believed to be a firearm in the suspect’s waistband,” said Boisvert.

The suspect then jumped into a vehicle and drove through Hartford with the officers in hot pursuit, which ended at Webster Court in Newington.

After the suspect got out of the car, there was an exchange of gunfire — which left both officers injured and the man dead at the scene.

The officers were rushed to hospital and listed in stable condition — however, the extent of their injuries is currently unknown.

A firearm was recovered at the scene, the outlet reported.
